sources.established: Voltage plus reversible expansion can improve identifiability of electrode-specific state under varied temperature, rate, depth-of-discharge, and pressure conditions.
sources.boundary: The public campaign emphasizes stress-factor coverage and pseudo-constant-pressure fixtures; it does not supply a new untouched 36-cell same-condition rank-confirmation block.

sources.established: Ninety-two cells tested across 47 duplicated protocols show that realistic dynamic discharge changes degradation and lifetime relative to constant current.
sources.boundary: The large total is intentionally protocol-diverse; two replicates per protocol cannot be pooled into one same-condition frailty block.

sources.established: Physics-guided, zero-shot, and active learning predicted industrial prototype life with 7.2% test error using first-50-cycle features from 51% of 123 prototypes.
sources.boundary: The 123 cells span 37 groups and the largest published relationship group contains 23; the claim does not validate the sealed R3 feature.

sources.established: A 0.38 nm-resolution capacitive dilatometer held pressure fluctuations below 0.8%; changing stack pressure produced a twofold lifetime shift and separated low-pressure cracking from high-pressure lithium plating.
sources.boundary: At least two cells per pressure support mechanism evidence but not population-level lifetime equivalence. The fixture is a causal intervention as well as a sensor.

sources.established: A current cross-source benchmark exposes processed file-to-aging-condition assignments across many chemistries and protocols.
sources.boundary: Dataset integration increases diversity but does not manufacture within-condition replication or raw specimen lineage.

proposedCombination.claim: A fair test of cell-level lifetime order may require both a large same-condition block and an orthogonal mechanical residual measured under a registered boundary condition.
proposedCombination.overlapWithPriorArt: Expansion diagnostics, active/minimal experiment selection, dynamic-load aging, and controlled-pressure dilatometry all exist separately.
proposedCombination.difference: RC58 combines an outcome-blind 48-cell acquisition manifest, a cycle-480 feature lock, attrition-conditioned endpoint cadence, an explicit measurement-intervention equivalence gate, and a pressure-adjusted expansion-residual test before ordinal confirmation.
proposedCombination.noveltyBoundary: No novelty is claimed. A prior-art search must target prospective block-randomized expansion residuals, schedule-equivalence testing, and outcome-blind lifetime-rank confirmation before any stronger statement.

minimumDecisiveTest.input: Sacrificial cells from the same build definition, independently calibrated pressure/expansion fixtures, and the frozen electrical protocol.
minimumDecisiveTest.measurement: Repeat reversible expansion at registered SOC landmarks; model fixture and pressure trajectory explicitly; compute expansion information conditional on the electrical R3 feature.
minimumDecisiveTest.success: Between-fixture repeatability passes its predefined limit and expansion reduces held-fixture prediction uncertainty or changes ordinal risk beyond R3 without degrading calibration.
minimumDecisiveTest.reject: Residual information vanishes after pressure adjustment, reverses across fixtures, or is smaller than calibration drift and positioning variance.
minimumDecisiveTest.stop: Any swelling, leakage, pressure excursion, temperature excursion, or evidence that the fixture changes aging outside the registered intervention margin stops the branch.
